comment: Splitting the macros into 3 parts so people know exactly what they're eating is such a thoughtful touch, most meal prep videos skip that completely. That's the exact problem we built Kunaz for, and it's free: add the chicken, rice and sauce once with their grams, set how many containers it makes, and it calculates calories, protein, carbs and fat per box for the whole week. Every food gets a health score from 0 to 100, so you can see at a glance how healthy a homemade dish like this really is, and your calorie deficit updates live during the day, which makes staying disciplined a lot easier. Thanks for keeping it cheap and simple!
